exposure: body mass index (BMI) of 50 or higher
finding: Weight gain below IOM guidelines in super-obese women was not associated with increased maternal or neonatal risk but was associated with decreased odds of macrosomia, while excessive weight gain increased the odds of pregnancy-induced hypertension and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Excessive weight gain statistically increased the odds of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Mentioned, with specific thresholds of >4,000g and >4,500g
